scientific_integrity: The fixed-node cubic-gap variance and Gaussian conditioning formula are prior results. The claim is their global joint-erasure optimum and strict optimized correlation penalty. Analytic proof, symbolic algebra and supplementary exact-arithmetic tests are included.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two nonadaptive, equally reliable, noiseless Brownian-bridge integral readings with jointly Bernoulli delivery; no extension to other kernels, noisy, heterogeneous or adaptive observations. Historical priority requires independent assessment.
title: Exact two-sensor Brownian-bridge quadrature under correlated observation erasures
